descriptionBody.en:
Why do moving a camera and changing its zoom give different views of the same world? First, real split-screen gameplay will help separate cameras from output windows, followed by a pixel-aspect calculation. Then we connect field of view with zoom numerically and compare that with moving the camera forward. Finally, orthographic projection and a split-screen exercise will show which parameters to change.

descriptionBody.en:
How does one corner of a game building end up at a specific screen position? First we follow landmarks in real games and calculate one point from object coordinates to camera coordinates. Next we clip the viewing volume, divide, and map through an output rectangle to obtain the screen coordinates. Finally, include the origin and size of a smaller viewport and complete the calculation of where that same point appears on screen.

descriptionBody.en:
What should a center point represent in a game? Using the same small triangle, compare the coordinate-average centroid, the incenter at equal distances from sides, and the circumcenter at equal distances from vertices. Tile placement, building edits, screen target markers and cave passages then show why one reference point differs from a complete boundary. Validate boundary order and distinguish convexity from concavity; the following episode continues with triangle partitioning. This first polygon lecture preserves the original explanations and calculations while adding comparisons across games.

앞 편에서 중심을 고르고 경계를 검사했습니다. 이번에는 여러 삼각형으로 나눈 뒤에도 원래 영역과 빈 공간이 그대로 남는지 확인합니다. 볼록한 도형의 부채꼴 분할과 오목한 도형의 실패 사례를 비교하고, 같은 L자 도형을 귀 잘라내기로 나누어 넓이 합7을 계산합니다. 건축의 문, 동굴의 통로, 공장 게임의 절단, 타일 배치를 비교하며 무엇을 남겨야 하는지 묻습니다. 공장 가공의 목표 조각과 원래 영역 전체를 보존하는 분할은 목적이 다릅니다. 마지막에는 유효한 분할과 좋은 삼각형 품질을 구분합니다. 기존 설명과 계산을 보존한 다각형 강의 두 번째 편입니다.

descriptionBody.en:
After choosing centers and validating boundaries, ask whether triangle pieces retain the original region and its empty space. Compare a convex fan with a failing concave fan, then ear-clip the same L shape and check its total area7. Building doorways, cave passages, factory cuts and tile placement reveal what each operation must retain. Producing selected factory pieces has a different goal from retaining the complete polygon region. Finally, distinguish a valid partition from good triangle quality. This second polygon lecture preserves the original explanations and calculations.

descriptionBody.en:
Does a triangle have just one center, and how can we partition terrain with an inward notch? We will observe real game tiles and terrain, then distinguish the questions answered by centroid, incenter and circumcenter. Next we will validate polygon boundaries and convexity, and examine the limits of a triangle fan. Finally we will partition a concave example by ear clipping and check coverage and thin triangles.
